name: Rate Limit Guard
description: Cross-session 429 rate-limit state tracking. Detects rate limit errors in tool calls and session errors, writes cooldown state to ~/.openclaw/rate_limits/{provider}.json (atomic writes), and injects a warning into the system prompt when a provider is still in cooldown. Prevents retry amplification. Ported from hermes-agent/agent/nous_rate_guard.py.

cooldownMs.description: Default cooldown duration in milliseconds when no reset header is available (default: 300000 = 5 minutes)

rateLimitsDir.description: Directory to store rate limit state files (default: ~/.openclaw/rate_limits)
